coverage: SessionLifecycleServiceTest: ported from services/scheduling's SessionServiceLockdownTest — LockdownMode derivation/override per ExamMode, patchPolicy partial update, incomplete-policy fail-fast; SnapshotRefService replaced with a mocked AssessmentService, plus a new test asserting the session stores the snapshot publicId AssessmentService.getSummary returns (not the raw request value).

EnrollmentServiceTest: ported from services/scheduling's own EnrollmentServiceTest, minus outbox verification (no OutboxWriter in the monolith) — bulk-enroll capacity check-then-insert, concurrent-race AlreadyEnrolledException, cross-session enrollment/proctor-assignment 404s.
EntitlementServiceTest (new): checkEntitlement/checkProctorAssignment trusted-caller paths — session not OPEN, student not enrolled, proctor not assigned, unknown session.
CompositionServiceTest (new): setComposition validates against AssessmentService.getSummary's live snapshot items each call — no local SnapshotRef cache; rejects a task type absent from the snapshot.
deviations: SnapshotFetchFailedException and EmptyCompositionException (dead code in source — the latter was never thrown anywhere in services/scheduling) were not ported; SnapshotRef/SnapshotRefItem caching and SnapshotEventConsumer were eliminated entirely per Design Constraints (session reads assessment's summary in-process, no cache table needed).

HostCommandService (requestScoring/requestPublish) and the SessionController /score and /publish endpoints were deferred to Phase 08 (scoring) and Phase 10 (reporting) — in source they only ever published an outbox event for a downstream service that doesn't exist yet in this monolith.

com.pte.session.dto.response required a @NamedInterface package-info.java (same pattern as itembank/assessment in the prior phase) — added proactively after the quality gate flagged it as a HIGH finding, even though no current caller triggers a Modulith verify() failure yet (attempt/proctoring don't exist until Phase 07/09).
